name: Fusion Flare
description: You summon a gigantic fireball that strikes down from the heavens in a 60 foot circle, centered on a point within range. All creatures caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If Fusion Bolt was already used this round, double the damage dealt. Fusion Flare may be used to thaw out the user from the frozen status before attacking.
